text: Evenepoel's time trial masterclass obliterated the competition on the roads around Lake Geneva, powering to a dominant 28-second victory over Pogačar and signaling a stunning reversal of fortune in the GC fight—the Belgian now sits just 4:32 behind after trailing by much more coming into the stage. Del Toro's fifth-place finish cemented his position as the third wheel, though the UAE pairing's depth means Pogačar retains control heading into the final mountain gauntlet. With Red Bull-Bora suddenly armed with momentum and Evenepoel proving he can hunt on his own terms, the race's narrative has abruptly shifted from coronation to genuine three-way war.
